MARCOX_AI.TITLE: MarcoXIA
MARCOX_AI.SUBTITLE: Thoughtful conversations, in every inbox.
MARCOX_AI.READ_ONLY: Only administrators can change agents and connections.
MARCOX_AI.EMPTY_BODY: Create an agent, give it your instructions and choose the inboxes it will serve.
MARCOX_AI.NO_AGENTS: Create an agent to start testing.

EDITOR.AUTO_START_HINT: When general support is enabled, start in new conversations from selected inboxes. When off, choose each conversation using its AI button.
EDITOR.TITLE: Agent settings
EDITOR.NAME: Agent name
EDITOR.PROMPT_HINT: Describe who your agent is, what it knows, how it speaks and when it should ask you for help.
EDITOR.PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: Write the instructions for this agent…
EDITOR.PROMPT_STARTER: Start with a natural support prompt
EDITOR.ENABLE_HINT: Enable support in selected inboxes. Individually enabled conversations keep working when this option is off.
EDITOR.BUFFER_HINT: Wait this many seconds after the last message, then reply to the whole thought.
EDITOR.HISTORY_HINT: Older messages are summarized into conversation memory.
EDITOR.TIMEZONE_HINT: Helps the agent understand message dates and times across the inboxes it handles.
EDITOR.PAUSE_FOREVER: Stay paused until I enable it
EDITOR.SPLIT_HINT: The agent separates ideas into messages, without breaking links or numbers.
EDITOR.REACTIONS_HINT: Use a contextual reaction when appropriate. Available in WhatsApp Direct.
EDITOR.GROUPS_HINT: When enabled, the agent can respond to every incoming group message.
EDITOR.INBOX_HINT: One agent can serve many inboxes. Each inbox has one agent, so replies never compete.
EDITOR.MODEL_MEDIA: This model supports images and documents.
EDITOR.MODEL_TEXT: This model supports text. Choose a vision model for images.
EDITOR.CONNECTION_REQUIRED: Connect this provider before enabling the agent.
EDITOR.SAVED_REQUIRED: Save the agent to test it.
EDITOR.CONFIRM_DELETE: Delete this agent and remove its inbox connections?
EDITOR.DISCARD_HINT: This agent has unsaved changes. Discard them to continue.

SECTION_HINTS.IDENTITY: Choose the name, model and connection this agent will use.
SECTION_HINTS.PROMPT: Define how this agent responds, what it knows and when it should hand over.
SECTION_HINTS.INBOXES: Choose where this agent starts responding. You can also select it for an individual conversation.
SECTION_HINTS.BEHAVIOR: Adjust context, message pacing and the media the agent can understand.
SECTION_HINTS.NOTIFICATIONS: Choose who receives alerts, when to pause support and how to resume the conversation.
SECTION_HINTS.VOICE: Configure voice, credentials and a private preview.

EDITOR.SHOW_TYPING_HINT: Shows typing while the agent prepares a reply. The inbox typing setting must also be enabled.
EDITOR.SHOW_RECORDING_HINT: Shows recording while an operator uses the microphone. Configure the agent's voice replies in Voice and audio.

PROVIDERS.TITLE: Connect the intelligence behind your agents
PROVIDERS.BODY: Your API keys stay on the server. Choose a model for each agent.
PROVIDERS.KEY_PLACEHOLDER: Paste a new key to connect or replace it
PROVIDERS.KEY_SAVED: Key saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
PROVIDERS.MODELS_SUGGESTED: Connect your account to verify available models
PROVIDERS.MODELS_ERROR: Could not load models. Check the connection.
PROVIDERS.GROQ_HINT: Fast inference. Media capabilities depend on the model.
PROVIDERS.GEMINI_HINT: Google models for text, images and documents.
PROVIDERS.SHARED_KEY: This provider key is shared by agents in this account. Each agent has its own model and instructions.

PLAYGROUND.TITLE: Make it sound like you
PLAYGROUND.BODY: Test the saved instructions in a private conversation. These messages are never sent to customers.
PLAYGROUND.START: Try a question, a voice note or an image.
PLAYGROUND.HANDOFF: Would hand off to a person: {reason}
PLAYGROUND.ERROR: The agent could not reply. Check the connection.
PLAYGROUND.FILE_LIMIT: Use up to 3 files, each at most 25 MB.

COVERAGE.TITLE: Conversations
COVERAGE.BODY: See where this agent is working and open individual conversations.
COVERAGE.TOGGLE_HINT: Controls support in selected inboxes. Individually enabled conversations have their own controls.
COVERAGE.DISABLED: General support disabled. Individually enabled conversations remain active.
COVERAGE.AUTOMATIC_HINT: The agent serves selected inboxes, respecting each conversation's pauses and its rules. Individual contacts are not listed in this mode.
COVERAGE.INDIVIDUAL_HINT: Only conversations with AI enabled are listed below. You can enable the agent in one conversation while general support is off.
COVERAGE.MANUAL_START: Automatic start is off. To serve new conversations in selected inboxes, enable it in the Conversation tab.
COVERAGE.COUNT: No conversations with AI enabled | {count} conversation with AI enabled | {count} conversations with AI enabled
COVERAGE.EMPTY: To start individual support, open the conversation, choose this agent and click Turn AI on.

ACTIVITY.TITLE: Keep an eye on the conversation
ACTIVITY.BODY: Recent responses, handoffs and errors for this agent. Message contents and API keys are not shown here.
ACTIVITY.EMPTY: Activity appears once this agent starts replying.

CONVERSATION.NO_AGENT: Create an agent in MarcoXIA to use it in this conversation.
CONVERSATION.RESUMED_OK: AI enabled for new messages in this conversation.
CONVERSATION.CONTINUE_OK: The agent is preparing a continuation.
CONVERSATION.LABEL: {name} · {status}
CONVERSATION.PANEL_HINT: Choose who assists this contact and control AI for this conversation.
CONVERSATION.FUTURE_ONLY: Turning on AI enables future messages only in this conversation, even when general support is off.
CONVERSATION.PANEL_CONTACT: Support for {name}. Control the agent and prepare replies.
CONVERSATION.AUTO_PAUSE: Pause automatically when requesting human help
CONVERSATION.AUTO_PAUSE_HINT: When off, AI can notify the team and keep talking according to its instructions. It does not resume an already paused AI; manual pause remains available.
CONVERSATION.AUTO_PAUSE_SAVED: Automatic pause updated for this conversation.
CONVERSATION.REPLY_NOW_OK: The agent is preparing a reply to send in this conversation.
CONVERSATION.REPLY_NOW_HINT: Generates and sends a reply to the current history using the selected agent, even if AI was off. To review before sending, use Analyze conversation below.

ANALYSIS.TITLE: Analyze history and prepare a reply
ANALYSIS.HINT: Analyzes the selected messages, including dates and times. Replies are only sent after your review.
ANALYSIS.PROCESSING: Reading history and preparing a reply…
ANALYSIS.OUTDATED: The conversation or agent changed. Analyze again before sending.
ANALYSIS.FAILED: Analysis failed. Check the agent connection and try again.
ANALYSIS.CONTEXT_HINT: Drag to choose the history. This selection also applies to future replies in this conversation.
ANALYSIS.CONTEXT_CHANGED: The context changed. Analyze again before sending.

COMPOSER.REFINE: Ask MarcoXIA to adjust this draft…

AUTOMATION.NUMBERS_HINT: One number per line, including +country code
AUTOMATION.RESOLVE_HINT: Resolving an alert does not reactivate AI.
AUTOMATION.DESTINATIONS_HINT: Default recipients for requests for a person. Each rule can have its own recipients.
AUTOMATION.PAUSE_HANDOFF: Pause when a person is needed
AUTOMATION.PAUSE_HANDOFF_HINT: Keep the assigned agent and wait for a human response.
AUTOMATION.ACK_HINT: Allow only the first message of the response after pausing.
AUTOMATION.RESUME_AFTER_HUMAN: After a human response and interval
AUTOMATION.RESUME_HINT: The interval starts after the last public human reply. A manual pause prevents automatic return.
AUTOMATION.TEMPLATE_HINT: Fields: contact, inbox, reason and url. Put each name inside braces.
AUTOMATION.TEST_HINT: Save first. This test sends operational notices to the saved recipients using the specified conversation as a reference.
AUTOMATION.PROMPT_SAVED_HINT: Shows saved instructions and runtime placeholders. Save your edits before inspecting. Credentials are excluded.
AUTOMATION.CALLS_HINT: Incoming missed or declined calls only. AI does not answer or decline calls.
AUTOMATION.RECENT_LIMIT: Recent messages used in each response
AUTOMATION.SUMMARY_STALE: Earlier messages changed. The summary will be rebuilt on the next response; you can also rebuild it now.
AUTOMATION.LINK_HINT: Approve another conversation only after confirming this is the same person. The agent uses this context only when the contact mentions a previous conversation. A phone number alone does not authorize access.
AUTOMATION.SOURCE_CONVERSATION: Conversation number in the other channel
AUTOMATION.SIMULATED_PAUSE: Simulation: AI would pause. No real conversation is modified.
AUTOMATION.SIMULATED_RECALL: Simulation: a request for approved context would be made.

WORKSPACE.MEMORY_HINT: Manage the AI context for this contact. Messages remain in the conversation history.
WORKSPACE.NO_MEMORY: No memory or context messages found.
WORKSPACE.FORGET_CONFIRM: Reset this contact’s AI memory in every inbox of this account? Previous messages will remain visible, but the AI will no longer use them. Pending replies will be cancelled.
WORKSPACE.SUMMARY_HINT: Edit the factual summary. New messages will update it as they leave the recent context window.
WORKSPACE.NO_RULES: Add a rule to choose which subjects require a notification.
WORKSPACE.RULE_HINT: Describe the subject that should trigger this alert.
WORKSPACE.INVALID_NUMBER: Enter the country code and number, starting with +.
WORKSPACE.NUMBER_HINT: Add one recipient at a time, with the country code. No digits will be added automatically.

VOICE.TITLE: Voice and audio
VOICE.HINT: Configure the agent voice. Replies stay in text without a key and voice ID. Audio is available on compatible messaging channels.
VOICE.ENABLED_HINT: Enable after configuring and reviewing the preview. Does not change support activation.
VOICE.MODE_CONTEXTUAL: When requested or appropriate in context
VOICE.KEY_HINT: The key is stored separately with encryption and never included in the prompt. An API key does not guarantee synthesis credits.
VOICE.SAVE_FIRST: Save the agent and changes before testing.
VOICE.ENCRYPTION: Encrypted server storage is required to save the key.
VOICE.ID_HINT: Use the API identifier. A display name such as Alice 03 may differ from the ID.
VOICE.SEND_TEXT_HINT: When off, send audio and retain links in text. Send the text response if synthesis fails.
VOICE.PRONUNCIATION_HINT: One replacement per line: term=spoken form
VOICE.PREVIEW_HINT: Generates private audio without sending it to a contact. Uses saved settings and may consume voice and text-normalization credits.
VOICE.ERROR: Unable to complete. Check saved settings, key, balance and voice ID.
VOICE.SIMULATED: Proposed audio in simulation — no audio generated or sent
VOICE.MIN_TEXT_TURNS_HINT: Counts complete replies, regardless of message splitting. A direct audio request can bypass this interval.
VOICE.LONG_MESSAGE_HINT: Approximate character length. The agent still chooses the format that fits the conversation.

SPLITTING.HINT: Groups short sentences and splits at natural punctuation. Preserves sentences, links, numbers and lists. Length is approximate; the message limit may join the remainder in the last bubble.
SPLITTING.GREETING: Separate greeting from the next sentence
SPLITTING.GREETING_HINT: Example: “Hi, Marcos!” followed by “How are you?”.

DESIGN.BODY: Manage your agents, inboxes and conversation context.

DECISION.HINT: See the recorded reason and find related instructions and controls.
DECISION.RECORDED: The record shows the request and rules triggered by the agent. It does not identify an exact prompt sentence as the cause.
DECISION.LEGACY: This older comment has no decision record. The sources below show current configuration to help with review.
DECISION.CHANGED: The agent configuration changed after this record.
DECISION.SOURCES_HINT: Review the current sources below. Shortcuts open the corresponding agent field for you to edit and save.
DECISION.PLATFORM_HINT: Platform guidance: the AI has no calendar or external actions. The pause switch controls conversation interruption without adding these capabilities.
DECISION.COMPOSER_HINT: Uses this conversation agent’s prompt and context. Suggestions are drafts; summaries are for you. These options do not send messages.
DECISION.EXCERPTS: Excerpts to review: text matches, without attributing an exact cause.

RESOURCES.TITLE: Files
RESOURCES.HINT: Give this agent images, videos, documents and links it can send when a contact asks. Each item has its own description and availability.
RESOURCES.EMPTY_HINT: Add a photo, an information sheet or a link, then describe when the agent should use it.
RESOURCES.SAVE_HINT: Items are saved here independently from the agent settings. Up to 100 items per agent. The AI sends them only in conversations where it is active.
RESOURCES.NAME: Name
RESOURCES.DESCRIPTION_HINT: This is the information sheet. Send it when someone asks for the sheet or available options.
RESOURCES.DESCRIPTION_HELP: Explain what this item contains, who or what it shows, and requests it answers. If several items look similar, make their differences clear.
RESOURCES.ENABLED_HINT: Disabled items are excluded from the agent catalog and future deliveries.
RESOURCES.FILE_LIMIT: Up to 40 MB: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV, PDF or TXT.
RESOURCES.DELETE_HINT: Delete “{name}” from this agent? Files already sent remain in the conversation history.
RESOURCES.ERROR: Unable to save or load this item. Please try again.
RESOURCES.SIMULATED: Selected item: {name}. This test does not send files.
